verify.subject: Confirm your e-mail address — Konkouré
verify.body: Confirm your e-mail address to activate your Konkouré account. This link is valid for 24 hours.

reset.subject: Reset your password — Konkouré
reset.body: A password reset was requested for your account. This link is valid for 1 hour and can be used once. If you did not request it, ignore this e-mail.

sessionCompromised.subject: Security alert on your account — Konkouré
sessionCompromised.body: One of your account sessions was reused in a suspicious way and has been closed as a precaution. If you do not recognize this activity, change your password.

invitation.subject: Invitation to join {organization} on Konkouré
invitation.body: {inviter} invites you to join {organization} on Konkouré as "{role}". This link is valid for 7 days.
